thread:
maya: Noticing a p95 increase on host ingress after the kern-align rollout (kern-align-20260320). Looks like tokenization + http2 flushes.

matt: can you share a perf summary?

maya: short perf slice from p95 traces:
```
42% host::tokenize::split_normalize
20% host::parse::proto_unwrap
13% net::http2::hpack_encode + flush
9% io::writev
6% kvcache::evict
```

maya: p95 went 115ms -> 127ms, tail shifted. writev count per req up ~1.7x on affected routes.

sam: did kernel-selection change chunk alignment again?

maya: yep, kern-align prefers smaller tiles for the utf path to improve GPU fill but it increases host chunking. fewer bytes per write.

kai: saw similar on canary yesterday. more small writes -> more hpack flushes -> syscall overhead.

ops-bot: deploy: kern-align rolled to prod-stable at 2026-03-20T04:55Z (rev: kern-align-20260320).

matt: quick plan: 1) add micro-metrics (maya) for write_syscalls and hpack_flush per req, 2) try flipping ingress proxy coalescer in narrow canary (kai), 3) bisect kernel-select knob if needed (matt).

maya: adding host.metric spans: host.tokenize.write_calls and http2.hpack.flushes (1% sample) now. also a small repro:
```
wrk -t40 -c40 -d20s --script ./scripts/stream_2k.lua http://ingress.local/generate
```

kai: toggling small-write coalescer on canary now. will report p95 delta after 10m.

sam: we should also check batch packing alignment; rounding changes could shrink effective batch packing even if tokens/batch target is unchanged.

maya: logs:
```
[ingress] req=aaa tokens=2020 writes=2 hpack_flushes=1 parse_ms=6 token_ms=20 writev_ms=12
[ingress] req=bbb tokens=2005 writes=5 hpack_flushes=4 parse_ms=9 token_ms=28 writev_ms=38
```

kai: canary coalescer ON -> preliminary: write_calls -45%, hpack_flushes -60%, p95 trending down. holding for 15m.

matt: if coalescer fixes tail, we can either keep it or adjust kernel-selection to respect a "streaming" tag and preserve previous tile sizes. I'll start a bisect to find the exact commit that altered tile rounding.

maya: update 3161234625: microtraces confirm write_calls up ~1.7x on prod-stable; canary coalescer restored p95 near baseline. continuing monitoring and prepping a short rollback playbook if needed.
